lines.en: label ayaneinvite1:
I tap on Ayane’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Ayane 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: I figure that if there’s anyone who would be happy to receive an invite to the house from me directly, it would be her.
lines.zh: 我想，如果有谁会因为收到我亲自发来的、来家里的邀请而开心的话，那一定是她。

lines.en: But, then again, there’s a good chance she’s already there right now if she went home with Ami.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，如果她跟 Ami 一起回了家，那她这会儿很可能已经在那儿了。

lines.en: If that were the case, I’d feel a little strange about calling her right now...but I guess it’s going to wind up being strange no matter what at this point.
lines.zh: 如果真是那样，我现在打电话给她就会有点怪……不过我想，事到如今不管怎样都会有点怪。

lines.en: As long as she agrees, that is.
lines.zh: 只要她答应就行。

lines.en: Which she will because she is Ayane.
lines.zh: 而她会答应的，因为她是 Ayane。

lines.en: : Yes! I will!
lines.zh: : 好！我愿意！

lines.en: : What? I haven’t even asked you anything yet.
lines.zh: : 什么？我还没问你什么呢。

lines.en: : Whatever you want, the answer is yes!
lines.zh: : 不管你想要什么，答案都是好！

lines.en: : Unless you’re breaking up with me. Then the answer is no.
lines.zh: : 除非你是要跟我分手。那答案就是不行。

lines.en: : We’re not even dating, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我们根本就没在交往啊，Ayane。

lines.en: : That’s okay! We don’t need to put a label on our love!
lines.zh: : 没关系！我们不需要给这份爱贴标签！

lines.en: : I’ll be excited to spend the rest of my life with you no matter what we call it~
lines.zh: : 不管我们怎么称呼它，我都会很兴奋地和你共度余生~

lines.en: : So, anyway, what was it you wanted?
lines.zh: : 那么，话说回来，你找我什么事？

lines.en: : I was going to see if you wanted to come over but now I might be having second-
lines.zh: : 我本来想问你要不要过来，不过现在我可能有点反——

lines.en: : I’m on my way!
lines.zh: : 我马上就到！

lines.en: Welp, any second thoughts I might have had don’t matter now.
lines.zh: 得，我可能会有的那点犹豫，现在都不重要了。

lines.en: scene black
Ayane is already on the way to the house...and since I'm the one who invited her over, a certain [niece] of mine might be a little taken aback by a sudden appearance from the bubble wrap princess.
lines.zh: Ayane 已经在往我家赶了……而既然是我邀请她来的，我那个 [niece] 大概会被这位泡泡纸公主的突然出现惊到一下。

lines.en: Especially an appearance that would likely begin with something along the lines of “I am here for your [uncle],” or whatever it is Ayane would say.
lines.zh: 尤其是一场很可能以“我是为你 [uncle] 而来的”之类的、Ayane 式台词开场的出现。

lines.en: So I guess I should hurry up and get home before something like that happens.
lines.zh: 所以我猜我该赶紧回家，别让那种事发生。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite1
I manage to show up at the house before Ayane makes it here and find Ami microwaving something in the kitchen.
lines.zh: 我赶在 Ayane 到之前回到了家，发现 Ami 正在厨房里微波什么东西。

lines.en: She tries to start a conversation with me but, knowing how things like this tend to go, I dismiss her entirely and make it seem like I’m in no mood to talk.
lines.zh: 她想跟我搭话，但我知道这种事一般会怎么发展，于是完全无视了她，摆出一副没心情说话的样子。

lines.en: An excellent strategy, if you ask me.
lines.zh: 要我说，这策略相当高明。

lines.en: This way, once Ayane makes it over, the two of us can quickly duck into my room before Ami has a chance to-
lines.zh: 这样一来，等 Ayane 到了，我们两个就能迅速闪进我的房间，赶在 Ami 有机会——

lines.en: : Open up! I’m ready for love!
lines.zh: : 开门！我已经准备好迎接爱了！

lines.en: Before Ami has a chance to find out that she’s here.
lines.zh: ——赶在 Ami 有机会发现她在这儿之前。

lines.en: The lock suddenly...unlocks?
lines.zh: 门锁突然……开了？

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite2
: Oh, good. You’re right here.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了。你正好在这儿。

lines.en: : I had to use my emergency key since you took too long to answer the door.
lines.zh: : 你开门太慢了，我只好动用我的备用钥匙。

lines.en: : You walked in two seconds after knocking.
lines.zh: : 你敲完门两秒钟就进来了。

lines.en: : And they were the longest, most painful two seconds of my life.
lines.zh: : 而那是我这辈子最长、最痛苦的两秒钟。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite3
: Thanks for inviting me over today, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你今天邀请我过来，Sensei。

lines.en: : Normally, it’s Ami who asks me to come over and I need to think up creative ways to get to you instead.
lines.zh: : 平时都是 Ami 叫我过来，我还得想出各种有创意的办法才能接近你。

lines.en: : I’m glad that she isn’t around and that I won’t have to do that today.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴她今天不在，这样我就不用那么做了。

lines.en: : Here’s the thing, Ayane. Ami {i}is{/i} around today.
lines.zh: : 问题{i}是{/i}，Ayane。Ami 今天在。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite4
: And you still invited me over?
lines.zh: : 那你还邀请我过来？

lines.en: : Do you have a deathwish?
lines.zh: : 你是活腻了吗？

lines.en: : No. I do not have a deathwish.
lines.zh: : 不是。我没有活腻。

lines.en: : Then are you trying to get {i}me{/i} killed? Because there is no way that one of those two things won’t be happening.
lines.zh: : 那你是想害死{i}我{/i}？因为这两件事里，肯定有一件会发生。

lines.en: : Especially since you called me over to have sex with me on her bed.
lines.zh: : 尤其是你把我叫来，是为了在她的床上跟我做爱。

lines.en: : It’s going to be fi-
lines.zh: : 不会有事——

lines.en: : Wait a second. That is {i}not{/i} why I called you over here.
lines.zh: : 等等。我可{i}不是{/i}因为这个才叫你来的。

lines.en: : It’s not?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : I feel like you gravely misinterpreted the purpose of this meeting.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你严重误解了这次见面的目的。

lines.en: : But we’ve already done it on my bed and your bed so the next logical step has to be hers, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 可我们已经在我的床上、你的床上都做过了，所以合乎逻辑的下一步就该是她的床了吧？

lines.en: : I just wanted to spend time with you...
lines.zh: : 我只是想和你待在一起……

lines.en: : With me or in me?
lines.zh: : 待在一起，还是待进我里面？

lines.en: : I’m very horny today.
lines.zh: : 我今天非常想要。

lines.en: : I can see that.
lines.zh: : 我看得出来。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite5
: I can’t imagine it will be easy doing something like that with Ami around, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我很难想象，有 Ami 在的时候做那种事能有多容易。

lines.en: : I mean, I guess we could wait until she’s in the bath or something, but-
lines.zh: : 我是说，也许我们可以等她去洗澡之类的，不过——

lines.en: : Why don’t we just hang out in my room and {i}not{/i} risk dismantling our relationship today?
lines.zh: : 我们为什么不干脆在我的房间里待着，今天就{i}别{/i}冒险把我们的关系给拆了？

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite6
: Ah! You said relationship! I {i}knew{/i} we were dating!
lines.zh: : 啊！你说了“关系”！我{i}就知道{/i}我们在交往！

lines.en: : No take backs, [ayanemaster]! I hereby pronounce us husband and wife!
lines.zh: : 不许反悔，[ayanemaster]！我在此宣布我们结为夫妻！

lines.en: : You may kiss the Ayane!
lines.zh: : 你可以亲吻 Ayane 了！

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite7
: Sensei? Is somebody else out here? I thought I heard-
lines.zh: : Sensei？外面还有别人吗？我好像听见——

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite8
: Ayane? What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : Ayane？你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Did we have plans to hang out today?
lines.zh: : 我们今天约好要一起玩吗？

lines.en: : I’m really sorry. I completely forgot.
lines.zh: : 真对不起。我完全忘了。

lines.en: : If you want to come hang out in my room, I’m watching this show about-
lines.zh: : 如果你想来我房间玩的话，我正在看一部讲——的节目

lines.en: : A-Actually, Ami...
lines.zh: : 其——其实，Ami……

lines.en: : I’m...here to...
lines.zh: : 我是来……

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite9
: I’m sorry. I don’t want to be the one to break her heart.
lines.zh: : 对不起。我不想做那个伤她心的人。

lines.en: : Ami is my best friend and I could never hurt her like this.
lines.zh: : Ami 是我最好的朋友，我绝不可能这样伤害她。

lines.en: : Hurt me like what? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 伤害我什么？你们在说什么？

lines.en: : Also, what are you still doing out here, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 还有，Sensei，你怎么还在这儿？

lines.en: : I thought you wanted to be left alone today?
lines.zh: : 我还以为你今天想一个人待着？

lines.en: : This whole situation is starting to feel really-
lines.zh: : 这整个情况开始让我觉得真的很——

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite10
: Hey, wait a second! I see what’s going on here!
lines.zh: : 嘿，等等！我看明白了！

lines.en: : You...do?
lines.zh: : 你……明白了？

lines.en: : You two were going to cook me a surprise dinner, weren’t you?!
lines.zh: : 你们两个是要给我做一顿惊喜晚餐，对吧？！

lines.en: : Yes.
: I did not come here to defile your bed.
lines.zh: : 我不是来糟蹋你的床的。

lines.en: : I came here to cook food.
lines.zh: : 我是来做饭的。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite11
: Sensei...you weren't in a bad mood after all. You were just upset because you saw me microwaving food instead of cooking dinner...
lines.zh: : Sensei……你原来不是心情不好啊。你只是看到我在微波食物、不做晚饭才生气的……

lines.en: : So you probably called the first name in your phone and had them rush over here to help since you can’t cook at all.
lines.zh: : 所以你大概是翻了通讯录里的第一个名字，叫人家赶紧过来帮忙，因为你自己根本不会做饭。

lines.en: : And since Ayane is the first name to come after Ami in your contacts, you just threw a Hail Mary and prayed she’d be free.
lines.zh: : 而 Ayane 是通讯录里排在 Ami 之后的第一个名字，所以你就随手扔了个孤注一掷的传球，祈祷她正好有空。

lines.en: : I’m so sorry that I worried you so much.
lines.zh: : 真对不起，让你这么担心我。

lines.en: : I’m okay, Ayane. You can go home now and I will spend the rest of the night comforting my [uncle].
lines.zh: : 我没事，Ayane。你现在可以回家了，剩下的夜晚我会用来安慰我的 [uncle]。

lines.en: : Actually-
lines.zh: : 其实——

lines.en: : I asked Ayane to hang out today.
lines.zh: : 是我叫 Ayane 今天来玩的。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite12
: You...what?
lines.zh: : 你……什么？

lines.en: : You mean you tried to call me in your phone and then...pressed her name on accident and felt bad about turning her away...or?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你本来想打给我，然后……不小心按到了她的名字，又因为不好意思赶她走才……还是怎样？

lines.en: : I really hope not. That would break my heart.
lines.zh: : 我真希望不是。那会伤透我的心。

lines.en: : No, I called her intentionally because I wanted to see her.
lines.zh: : 不是，我是有意打给她的，因为我想见她。

lines.en: : So...you probably just assumed I was working or something then, right?
lines.zh: : 所以……你大概是以为我在上班什么的，对吧？

lines.en: : Cause there’s no reason you’d ever...call her instead of me...
lines.zh: : 因为你根本没有任何理由……不找我而去找她……

lines.en: : {i}Just roll with it, Sensei. This is the best escape route you’re going to get.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}顺着说吧，Sensei。这是你能拿到的最好的退路了。{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah, sure. Why not.
lines.zh: : 嗯，对。为什么不呢。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite13
: Jeez...Just check with me next time, Sensei...Do you really get lonely that easily?
lines.zh: : 天哪……下次先跟我说一声行不行，Sensei……你真的那么容易寂寞吗？

lines.en: : You don’t have to invite people here just because you think I’m going to be away.
lines.zh: : 你不用因为觉得我会不在家，就邀请别人过来。

lines.en: : In fact, if you close your eyes and think of me, it’s almost like I’m always there! Or something!
lines.zh: : 事实上，只要你闭上眼睛想着我，那感觉几乎就像我一直都在！大概吧！

lines.en: : Hahaha...hahahahah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈哈哈哈哈……

lines.en: This level of denial is something I’d expect from a relapsing drug addict, not a girl catching her [uncle] spending time with one of her friends.
lines.zh: 这种程度的自我欺骗，我本来以为只会出现在一个复发的瘾君子身上，而不是一个撞见自己 [uncle] 正在和她某个朋友待在一起的女孩身上。

lines.en: Though, to be fair, both of those things sound kind of bad when put into words.
lines.zh: 不过说句公道话，这两件事说出来听起来都挺糟。

lines.en: If anything, mine might actually sound worse.
lines.zh: 要说的话，我这个听起来可能更糟。

lines.en: But that doesn’t change the fact that I {i}did{/i} invite Ayane to the house today, and abandoning her now of all times would be too rude even for me.
lines.zh: 但这改变不了我今天{i}确实{/i}邀请了 Ayane 来家里的事实，而现在这种时候把她丢下，连我都觉得太过分了。

lines.en: I just have to think of a way to get Ami out of the picture- which might actually be a little harder than normal given that she’s on high alert right now.
lines.zh: 我只用想个办法把 Ami 支开——考虑到她现在正处于高度戒备状态，这大概比平常要难一点。

lines.en: : Well...I {i}did{/i} promise Ayane that the two of us could do something tonight, so if you could-
lines.zh: : 这个……我{i}确实{/i}答应了 Ayane 我们两个今晚要做点什么，所以如果你能——

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite14
: Actually...
lines.zh: : 其实……

lines.en: : How about we all just hang out together? Like old times.
lines.zh: : 不如我们三个一起玩吧？像以前那样。

lines.en: : You mean like...when you first started coming over a billion years ago?
lines.zh: : 你是说像……你十亿年前刚开始来这儿的时候那样？

lines.en: : Yeah, before Maya came into the picture.
lines.zh: : 对，在 Maya 出现之前。

lines.en: : That makes it sound like you don’t like Maya.
lines.zh: : 这听起来好像你不喜欢 Maya。

lines.en: : I love Maya. But you and Sensei are basically family to me.
lines.zh: : 我爱 Maya。但你和 Sensei 对我来说基本就是家人。

lines.en: : So spending time with the two of you like how we used to is really all I could ask for.
lines.zh: : 所以能像从前那样和你们俩一起度过，真的是我别无所求的事。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite15
Ayane and I lock eyes for a moment and I honestly can’t tell whether or not she’s actually okay with this.
lines.zh: Ayane 和我对视了一瞬，我真的看不出她是不是真的能接受这样。

lines.en: Her words sound sincere but, just a few moments ago, she was over the moon at the prospect of hanging out alone with me.
lines.zh: 她的话听起来很真诚，但就在几分钟前，她还为能跟我单独相处而乐上了天。

lines.en: Taking that away from her now seems like it would just be adding more weight to the burden she already carries in hiding (Or at least {i}trying{/i} to hide) her feelings for me.
lines.zh: 现在把这从她身上拿走，看起来只会给她本来就背着的那个重担再加分量——那个她藏着的（或者至少在{i}努力{/i}藏着的）对我的感情。

lines.en: : {i}Are you really okay with that?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你真的可以接受吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Of course.{/i}
: {i}Hearing you stand up for me made me happier than getting pounded on Ami’s bed ever would.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}听到你为我说话，比在 Ami 的床上被你操要让我开心得多。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That’s not a thing you should be whispering with her right there.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这话你不该当着她的面低声说。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’m going to go home and [masturbate] to you tonight.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我今晚要回家 [masturbate] 想你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Cool.{/i}
: Uhh...guys?
lines.zh: : 呃……两位？

lines.en: : If the {i}three{/i} of us are going to hang out, you should probably stop whispering to each other.
lines.zh: : 如果我们{i}三个{/i}要一起玩，你们大概该别再互相咬耳朵了。

lines.en: : I’d like to be included too, you know.
lines.zh: : 我也想被算进去，好吗。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite16
: Oh, of course!
lines.zh: : 哦，当然！

lines.en: : Sorry, Ami. I was just striking up a compromise with Sensei since we’ve now included you in our plans.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Ami。我只是在跟 Sensei 谈个条件，毕竟我们现在把你加进计划里了。

lines.en: : What kind of compromise?!
lines.zh: : 什么条件？！

lines.en: : What happened to all that stuff about the “old times” or whatever?! Why is there suddenly a condition?!
lines.zh: : 那些“像以前那样”的话都去哪儿了？！怎么突然冒出个条件？！

lines.en: : It’s a simple condition.
lines.zh: : 是个很简单的条件。

lines.en: : All I ask is that I get to hold Sensei’s hand for the rest of the day while you stay ten feet away from us.
lines.zh: : 我只要求今天剩下的时间里，我能牵着 Sensei 的手，而你要跟我们保持十英尺的距离。

lines.en: : I might as well be in a different room at that point!
lines.zh: : 那我还不如待在另一个房间里算了！

lines.en: : Well, if that’s what you’d prefer, then feel free to-
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果你更喜欢那样的话，尽管——

lines.en: : Unhand my [uncle], Ayane! Your compromise is denied!
lines.zh: : 放开我 [uncle]，Ayane！你的条件被驳回！

lines.en: : If anyone is holding Sensei’s hand, it is his [niece] and your {i}alleged{/i} best friend!
lines.zh: : 要牵 Sensei 的手，那也该是他的 [niece]、也就是你{i}所谓的{/i}最好的朋友来牵！

lines.en: : Let the record show that I have two hands and can easily solve this problem for everyone.
lines.zh: : 请记录在案：我有两只手，可以轻松为所有人解决这个问题。

lines.en: : See, Ami? I was even kind enough to leave his other hand available for you.
lines.zh: : 看到了吧，Ami？我甚至好心地把他另一只手留给你了。

lines.en: : As long as you’re able to remain ten feet away, that is.
lines.zh: : 只要你能保持十英尺的距离就行。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite17
: Sensei’s super tall but even {i}his{/i} stupid hand won’t reach that far! This is an unrealistic condition!
lines.zh: : Sensei 是高得离谱，可{i}他{/i}那只蠢手也伸不了那么远！这条件根本不现实！

lines.en: : Five feet?
lines.zh: : 五英尺？

lines.en: : No!
lines.zh: : 不行！

lines.en: : Four?
lines.zh: : 四英尺？

lines.en: : Still no!
lines.zh: : 还是不行！

lines.en: : Okay, okay. Fine. You’re free to hold his other hand. But I also get to rest my head on his shoulder when we sit on the couch.
lines.zh: : 好吧，好吧。行。你可以牵他另一只手。但我们坐沙发的时候，我也得把头靠在他肩膀上。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite18
: Then so...do...I...
: I’m gonna cuddle with him in ways that someone like you could never even imagine...
lines.zh: : 我要以你这种人根本想象不到的方式跟他抱在一起……

lines.en: : Oh? Is that a challenge, Ami?
lines.zh: : 哦？这是在向我挑战吗，Ami？

lines.en: : I’m sure you remember how our last challenge ended up, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你肯定还记得我们上一次挑战的结果吧？

lines.en: : You mean the cooking one?
lines.zh: : 你是说做饭那次？

lines.en: : I defeated you. I asserted dominance.
lines.zh: : 我击败了你。我确立了统治地位。

lines.en: : You may have won, yes...
lines.zh: : 你是赢了，没错……

lines.en: : But who got to hold the giant banana?
lines.zh: : 可最后是谁拿到了那根巨大的香蕉？

lines.en: scene ayanefirstinvite19
: A...ya...neeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : A……ya……neeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee!!!!!!!!!!!

lines.en: : {i}This banana belongs to me...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这根香蕉是我的……{/i}

lines.en: scene black
And that basically explains how the rest of the night went.
lines.zh: 这基本就解释了今晚剩下的时间是怎么回事。

lines.en: Ayane and Ami proceeded to fight over me for the next several hours, using my arms like some sort of tug-of-war rope and leaving me broken and bruised by the time the day ended.
lines.zh: 接下来的几个小时里，Ayane 和 Ami 继续为了争夺我而大打出手，把我的两条胳膊当成了拔河绳，等这一天结束时，我已经被折腾得浑身酸痛。

lines.en: But even though it’s become hard to feel my fingers, it was nice seeing two girls who care so much about me fight each other like that.
lines.zh: 不过，尽管我的手指都已经没什么知觉了，看着两个这么在乎我的女孩那样互相争抢，感觉还不错。

lines.en: I kind of wish they would have pulled each other's hair or something, though.
lines.zh: 不过我倒是有点希望她们能互相扯扯头发什么的。

lines.en: That’s what this night {i}really{/i} needed.
lines.zh: 那才是今晚{i}真正{/i}需要的东西。
